workflow_runs.name: migration-lint
workflow_runs.display_title: feat(knowledge): activate the publication submit seam for authenticated callers

head_commit.message:
feat(knowledge): activate the publication submit seam for authenticated callers

The packet gated submit activation on the native worker adoption being live —
it is (20270533100000 production-verified: worker drives start->embed->stage->
complete, submit wakes it at creation, recover requeues missed wakes), and the
fake-provider worker contract is mutation-pinned by 14 tests.

20270533200000 grants EXECUTE to authenticated only. submit stays a JWT-caller
RPC: PostgreSQL derives the actor from the session and re-checks tenant
authority inside the function; no caller-actor parameter, no service-role
impersonation. start/stage/complete/settle/recover remain service-only; anon
and PUBLIC stay revoked.

Behavior proofs flip the dormant boundary to the live one and pin, as the
authenticated caller: submit of the saved exact review, exact intent replay
returning the same work (no second publication), a fresh intent refused
KNOWLEDGE_PUBLICATION_PENDING, a non-selected tenant refused
KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE_CHANGED, revision drift refused KNOWLEDGE_REVISION_CONFLICT,
anon still permission-denied, and the post-publication boundary (promotion
severs extraction_work_id, so the consumed pair can never resubmit — a
re-publication requires the fresh extraction/review the second-publication
scenario proves).

Client seam: submitKnowledgePublication in knowledge-service.ts (document
echo anchors scope — the RPC response carries no tenant envelope; creation
must echo the frozen revision; replay carries no revision), 13 unit tests.
